propositions: The dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on git fetch origin tickets with exit 128 but raises CalledProcessError whose message contains only the exit status, discarding git's stderr which would explain the cause
git's captured stderr is routed into a buffer by capture_output=True but then discarded when check=True raises CalledProcessError, making the failure undiagnosable
The git fetch call on the critical path is un-retried and a single transient network blip marks the entire 41-minute live job as ERROR

The fixture's git fetch, archive, and ls-tree calls must route through a common helper that performs the check itself and raises RuntimeError carrying the joined command, exit status, and verbatim stderr
The fetch must retry transient failures a bounded number of times with backoff before failing permanently, ensuring genuine misconfiguration still fails red rather than silently skipping coverage
